lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: Hurgh... what was that idiot *doing* bringing me here?

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: It's... wait a minute... I can feel it...

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: I can finally see its beauty: The lush blue fields, the crystal clear waters, the wind brushing past my...

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: Huh... no wonder I feel at home.

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: ♫ Egao urutora zetto de ♫ (With a smile that’s Ultra-Z)

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: ♫ Kyô mo ai-yai-yai-yai-yai~ ♫ (Even today is ai-yai-yai-yai-yai~)

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: Well, Vegeta - you've finally pulled it off. You've managed to dash my hopes entirely.

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: I'm very curious - where exactly are you from?

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Oh, right. Thanks for stopping me Gohan, 'cause I can't shut--

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: Oh good! I'll stop by there on the way home.

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: Pick up some space eggs, some space milk, and BLOW IT THE F**K UP!!

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: Oh, I'm sorry. I'm usually far more composed. I'm just a little bit ABSOLUTELY LIVID.

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Oh Freeza, quit being such a woman.

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: I lost my chance at immortality too and you don't see me crying about it.

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: Yes Vegeta, but you see, the difference between us is I'll live long enough to regret it.

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: 'Hurgh... everything looks the goddamn same on this GOD DAMN PLANET.'

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: Please tell me you're not dead.

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: Ah crap, I find the only living thing for miles and he's so broken he can't even talk right.

lines.speaker: Nail
lines.text: I was speaking Namekian, you idiot. Don't you know anything about your own people?

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: I liked it better when I was a demon.

lines.speaker: Nail
lines.text: And I liked it better when I had proper bladder control. Nobody's perfect.

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: Yeah, I've been meaning to ask about that; what happened?

lines.speaker: Nail
lines.text: Let's just say our world elder's kind of a giant green asshole.

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: Preaching to the choir on that one.

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: Well, its been fun, but I have to go *die* again.

lines.speaker: Nail
lines.text: Wait! I *might* be able to help you.

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: Look buddy, if you wanna add me on MySpace, I switched to Spacebook a while ago.

lines.speaker: Nail
lines.text: No no, no no, listen. I think I know something that might work out for both of us.

lines.speaker: Nail
lines.text: I don't wanna die, and you seem pretty lonely.

lines.speaker: Nail
lines.text: There's a special ability our people share, forbidden, even amongst our most sacred clans.

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: And we're just going to abuse it?

lines.speaker: Nail
lines.text: Well - first you put your hand upon me.

lines.speaker: Nail
lines.text: Ahh, if we had junk, you'd be gay right now.

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: THIS IS AMAZING! I FEEL INCREDIBLE!

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: I CAN WIN! I FEEL GREAT! I! CAN! DO! THIS! AAAAAGH!

lines.speaker: Nail
lines.text: '*Really*? 'Cause it looked like you were chanting to yourself.'

lines.speaker: Nail
lines.text: 'Yup. Don't worry - supposedly I should fade away into your subconscious... sooner or later.'

lines.speaker: Nail
lines.text: 'By my estimate, this fusion should have given you just enough power to wipe out the *bastard* who killed our people.'

lines.speaker: Nail
lines.text: 'Well, let me put this in terms you'll understand:'

lines.speaker: Nail
lines.text: 'YOU CAN WIN! YOU FEEL GREAT! YOU! CAN! DO! THIS!'

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: I'm impressed, Vegeta! When did you graduate from pull-ups?

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: 'Bout the same time you got off the rag.

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: Cute. But bear no false hope, Vegeta. You're a mere paper tiger in front of a storm.

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: You have no idea what true power I possess.

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: It's that you can transform, right?

lines.speaker: Guldo
lines.text: Did you know that Freeza can transform?

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: And then I threw a dog treat at him. True story.

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: Right... but if you are so aware, why do you persist in goading me?

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Because Freeza, you're not dealing with the average Saiyan warrior anymore.

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: That's right, Freeza. I've risen beyond the limits of a normal Saiyan and into the realm of legend... the legend that you fear... the legend, known throughout the entire Universe, as the most powerful warrior to ever exist!

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: I, Prince Vegeta, have become a Super Saiyan!

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: "Vegeta, have become a Super Saiyan", blah blah blah blah, I get it!

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: Then you slayed the Jabberwocky and went on to save Narnia.

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Go ahead and mock me Freeza, but I'm not afraid of you.

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: So why don't you doll yourself up and get ready for a night on the town, because I'm about to take you to a ballroom blitz.

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: Fine, I'll indulge you Mr. "Super Saiyan", but before I do I have a funny little story I'd like to tell you.

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: I like to call it "I Killed Your Dad".

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: You see, thanks to a rogue lower-class warrior, your father caught wind of my plans.

lines.speaker: Butarega
lines.text: King Vegeta, I have urgent news!

lines.speaker: Butarega
lines.text: He's been telling everyone that Freeza plans to destroy Vegeta!

lines.speaker: King Vegeta
lines.text: Wait - my son, the planet or me?

lines.speaker: King Vegeta
lines.text: Councillor Nappa, what do you think?

lines.speaker: Councillor Nappa
lines.text: Let me tell you what you need to do:

lines.speaker: Councillor Nappa
lines.text: You need to sit him down,

lines.speaker: Councillor Nappa
lines.text: you look him dead in the eye,

lines.speaker: Councillor Nappa
lines.text: and you say: "Don't blow up my planet."

lines.speaker: Councillor Nappa
lines.text: He'd have to be awwwfully evil if it didn't.

lines.speaker: Councillor Nappa
lines.text: I like the cut of his jib.

lines.speaker: King Vegeta
lines.text: Alright. But I want you to take my son, the Prince, off-planet just in case things go south.

lines.speaker: Councillor Nappa
lines.text: Don't worry sir, you'll do juuust fine.

lines.speaker: King Vegeta
lines.text: Freeza, can I sit down and have a word--?

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: And then I blew the planet up. The End!

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: How did you know about the parts you weren't there for?

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: All done. And judging by the expression on your face, so are you.

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: Let's be practical and put a number to that feeling, shall we? Last time I clocked this form, it was at:

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Not impressed! I can do that too!

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Yeah! And I've got Little Green right here.
♫ A dark parody of "My Favorite Things" ♫

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: ♫ Peaceful young races with fires on their houses ♫

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: ♫ Millions of voices all silenced like mouses ♫

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: ♫ Watching the cowards bow toward their new king ♫

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: ♫ These are a few of my favorite things ♫

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Is it just me, or is he singing to himself?

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: Sure it isn't THIS? Or THIS? Or THIS? Or THIS? Or THIS?
Krillin continues to cry out in pain

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Krillin, stop! You're making him stronger!

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: Ah, I think impalement is my favorite way to kill a person.

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: GOHAN SMASHED EFFEMINATE ALIEN! GOHAN STRONGEST THERE IS!

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Yeah! How's that feel, Freeza?! Now if you can, why don't ya pick ya sorry ass up, and take on a *real* Saiya--?! an-na-na-na-na-naa...

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: Vegeta, mind sitting right there for just a moment? I need to go play babysitter.

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: 'Uh, think! What would Dad do in this situation?'

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: 'I'm beginning to think I have issues.'

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: So Vegeta, does this get you an-gry?

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Not really; kind of a smartass.

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: Well then, why am I even bothering?

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Because you get off on it?

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Kiss my ass bitch! I'm immortal!

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: 'How the hell did he get up?! Oh my God, I swear if he used that wish of immortality *on himself*, I AM GOING TO MURDER--!'

lines.speaker: Dende
lines.text: Come on, you can't leave me alone here; you're the only one I can talk to!

lines.speaker: Dende
lines.text: You are the only one I respect.

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Then why did you heal Krillin?

lines.speaker: Dende
lines.text: The better question is: Why did I tell him he was immortal?

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Holy crap! Thank God I'm immortal!

lines.speaker: Dende
lines.text: Actually I healed you, you idiot!

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Wait... so I could've *died* back there?

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Yeah; and unlike the runt and I, you don't get a power boost from it.

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Oh, it was awesome! See, he was gaining on me there for a minute,

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: but then I managed to lose him in some crevices, but he kept cutting me off at every pass!

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: He didn't just blow it up?

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: I thought the same thing, but no! So I thought fast and used the Solar Flare on him!

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: And then you used your Kienzan to cut him in half?

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: I WILL MOUNT YOUR HEAD WHERE MY TAIL USED TO BE!!

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: To answer your question, Gohan: No, I did not do that.

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Krillin, we can feel his energy. Why do you bother asking?

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Y'know what? I'm sick of this!

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: If I'm gonna die, then I'm gonna go out the same way Piccolo would!

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: Well, well, well! I'm legitimately surprised I missed one of you.

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: But that's just fine, because I've been working on some jokes. Now tell me if you've heard this one:

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: How many Namekians does it take to--?

segments.title: GOD, THIS IS BORING!
segments.quote: I can finally see its beauty: ... GOD, THIS IS BORING! Huh... no wonder I feel at home.

segments.title: BLOW IT THE F**K UP!!
segments.quote: Pick up some space eggs, some space milk, and BLOW IT THE F**K UP!! ... I'm just a little bit ABSOLUTELY LIVID.

segments.title: Slug People
segments.quote: Kill... that... douche... — ...he's so broken he can't even talk right. ... Eh, more like slug people.

segments.title: If We Had Junk
segments.quote: Ahh, if we had junk, you'd be gay right now. — Hurrgh! — Fusing!

segments.title: YOU CAN WIN! (Nail in His Head)
segments.quote: 'YOU CAN WIN! YOU FEEL GREAT! YOU! CAN! DO! THIS!' — OH HA HA!

segments.title: And Burter's Gay
segments.quote: Did you know that Freeza can transform? ... Yeah. And Burter's gay. — *Really*?

segments.title: I, Prince Vegeta...
segments.quote: I, Prince Vegeta, have become a Super Saiyan! — blah blah blah blah, I get it! Then you slayed the Jabberwocky and went on to save Narnia.

segments.title: SHORYUKEN!
segments.quote: Freeza, can I sit down and have a word--? — SHORYUKEN! ... How did you know about the parts you weren't there for?

segments.title: One Million
segments.quote: Last time I clocked this form, it was at: *One Million*. — You're lying! — Am I? Am I really?

segments.title: A Few of My Favorite Things
segments.quote: ♫ Peaceful young races with fires on their houses ♫ ... Is it just me, or is he singing to himself?

segments.title: GOHAN SMASHED!
segments.quote: GOHAN SMASHED EFFEMINATE ALIEN! GOHAN STRONGEST THERE IS!

segments.title: Just One
segments.quote: How many Namekians does it take to--? — D'HOAAR! — Just one.
